title: Import customers from CSV
description: Create new customers from a CSV file. Review the result before saving; existing customers are never changed or merged.
limits: Up to 1,000 rows and 1 MiB · UTF-8 · first row is the header
keepFile: The file is not stored. Confirming uses the file kept on this page, so do not refresh or close it while importing.
mapHint: Pick the file column for each field. A customer name is required.
rowDuplicate: May duplicate a customer you can see
noValid: No rows pass, so nothing can be imported
invalidSkipped: Rows that fail will not be imported
confirmBody: This creates {{count}} new customers. It cannot be undone from this page, and you become the custodian of the customers created.
confirming: Importing. Do not close or refresh this page.
resultIncomplete: Import is not complete. Resume without creating duplicates.
